scenario.name: sni_28d
scenario.notes: SNI pilot scenario. Seeds are proximal injury drivers resolved against the real card set: microglial activation, TNF-alpha, ROS/oxidative stress, MMP-9, BDNF, HIF1-alpha. No DAMP card exists in the set; its canonical receptor TLR4 (tlr4_tlr4) is seeded as the DAMP-signaling proxy. Seed magnitude 0.92: orphan nodes contract toward baseline by a factor of ~0.637 per tick, so only seeds >= ~0.87 satisfy first_crossing with delta=0.15 and sustain=2 for two consecutive logged ticks. Sustained drives model tonic injury drivers after SNI: ongoing ectopic afferent firing and persistent glial activation keep microglia and TNF-a elevated through the whole horizon (value 0.9 from tick 0, no end tick = active while start <= tick < horizon).
